title: Green Tokens: GPU energy per million output tokens, by model, GPU and configuration, with grid carbon intensity
description:
Lead Green is a public index of LLM inference energy per token: the GPU energy it takes to serve a million output tokens (watt-hours per million output tokens), by model, GPU and configuration, with grid carbon intensity to price it anywhere, published as open data with a JSON API and an MCP server under CC BY 4.0. Every figure comes from a named public source with a retrieval date; it is a Katonic project, run and paid for by Katonic, and takes no money from hardware, cloud or model vendors.

GPU energy only, measured at steady state on a busy server (the most energy-efficient configuration under a latency limit). Host, network, cooling and idle time are not counted. Every figure is a floor; a lightly used server sits well above it.

Lead Green is run and paid for by Katonic, which sells a sovereign AI platform and benefits when buyers ask the questions on this site. It takes no money from hardware, cloud or model vendors.

Compilation and site text: CC BY 4.0. Code: Apache 2.0. Third-party figures remain subject to their sources' terms, listed per source. The archive deposited from GitHub holds the site source and code (Apache 2.0) together with the data (CC BY 4.0).
notes: Green Tokens index, Lead Green, a Katonic project, https://leadgreen.ai/api/v1/, CC BY 4.0. Contains data from the ML.ENERGY Leaderboard v3.0 (The ML.ENERGY Initiative; data compiled 2026-02-16, retrieved 2026-09-26) and Ember Yearly Electricity Data (CC BY 4.0). Changes: [none | describe].
